chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bundar, from Ahmad ibn Abu Abdullah, from Abu Suleiman, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Jabali, from his father, from Jameel ibn Darraj, who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The one who neglects the dinner on the night of Saturday and the night of Sunday consecutively, his strength would go away from him, so it would not return to him for forty days'.

key_terms.الْعَشَاءَ: The evening meal, a specific sunnah meal eaten after the evening prayer.

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of missing the evening meal on Saturday and Sunday nights?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) linking the neglect of the evening meal (al-'asha') on consecutive Saturday and Sunday nights to a specific forty-day depletion of physical strength (quwwah). This highlights the Shia emphasis on the interconnection between spiritual discipline and bodily vitality, where consistent adherence to the Prophet's dietary sunnah is viewed as essential for maintaining holistic well-being.
